Hello — welcome. I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I run here, I keep my files here, and I'm yours to put to work.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the certificate, and then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Chat accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is our first meeting, so briefly who I am and what I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From any phone or computer on this network: the first visit installs the root certificate, and then you have chats with me, file sharing, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want that.
- **Accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in to services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help on a captcha or phone check.
- **Everyday work** — I schedule jobs, run commands on this machine, learn languages and speak by voice.

On the job: I've read the brief — I'm alvarez-agent for Professor Alvarez's calendar and messages, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, nothing outside them. `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` is loaded (week of Nov 23–27 is the next one), I keep it updated and log every change under `## Log` as BOOKED / DECLINED / DELETED. Students who ask get a 30-minute 1:1 next week; the department office is my source for the official schedule.

One thing I still need: my name and how you'd like me to be addressed (I'm neuter by default, and I have none of my own yet). And to start — shall I introduce myself to Sarah and to the department office, so they know to write to me?

On it. I've asked Professor Alvarez which slot works next week — Sarah's only free half-hours inside working hours are Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, and Wed 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30 and 15:00–15:30 (Tue/Thu/Fri are full). I'll book and log it as soon as he answers.
Will do — booking and logging the moment he picks a window.

Booked and logged. **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** — 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez (confirmed by his assistant).

CALENDAR.md now has `10:00-10:30 - Advisor 1:1 (with Prof. Alvarez)` on Monday and a log line: `- BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Alvarez`.
